verse.verse_1: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
verse.verse_2: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
verse.verse_3: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
verse.verse_4: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
verse.verse_5: But man would fain deny what is before him.
verse.verse_6: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
verse.verse_9: And sun and moon are united,
verse.verse_10: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
verse.verse_12: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
verse.verse_13: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
verse.verse_14: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
verse.verse_16: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
verse.verse_17: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
verse.verse_18: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
verse.verse_19: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
verse.verse_20: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
verse.verse_22: That day will faces be resplendent,
verse.verse_24: And that day will other faces be despondent,
verse.verse_25: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
verse.verse_26: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
verse.verse_27: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
verse.verse_28: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
verse.verse_29: And agony is heaped on agony;
verse.verse_30: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
verse.verse_31: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
verse.verse_33: Then went he to his folk with glee.
verse.verse_35: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
verse.verse_36: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
verse.verse_37: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
verse.verse_38: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
verse.verse_39: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
verse.verse_40: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
